identifier.value: Centralized Risk and Compliance Management Platform

product.name: Centralized Risk and Compliance Management Platform
product.description: A platform that centralizes financial, compliance, and risk information of suppliers and clients using AI and key integrations for a 360° view.

product.name: AI Document Analysis and Classification
product.description: An AI-driven tool that analyzes and classifies documents to assist in review processes and detect fraudulent documents.

product.name: Automated Fraud Prevention Alerts
product.description: A system that automatically sends alerts about potential money laundering, economic crimes, or conflicts of interest.

product.name: Approval Workflow Management
product.description: A departmental approval system with detailed decision records to ensure team collaboration and process transparency.

product.name: Third-Party Risk Lifecycle Management
product.description: A solution to manage risks associated with third parties throughout their entire lifecycle, from onboarding to contract management.
